cart.note: lists only Wheel: Axle comes by Wheel's requirement, and Transform by Axle's

oiled.note: lists only what cart already requires, so it is in cart's family

mill.note: lists Axle, which Hub requires, so no requirement adds it

carter.note: Driver requires Actions, which has no default ctor, so it is listed

pair.note: Left and Right require each other: a circle is allowed

crate.note: lists only the engine's Mesh: Transform, the world tier's, and Material, the frame tier's, come by its requirements, as the hello cube's do

lens.note: lists only the engine's Camera: its Transform comes by its requirement

beam.note: lists only the engine's Light: its Transform comes by its requirement
